business_problem: However, siloed data systems made it difficult to manage their data in a unified way, creating data engineering overhead that slowed time to insight for the business. Reliant on their own databases to perform business analytics, Jobis & Villains met with many data management and utilization challenges.
solution_summary: Jobis & Villains has been at the forefront of the digital transformation within the Korean tax market, providing innovative AI accounting services to over 19 million registered users through their SamjumSam platform. With their data-driven technology, they aim to lower the barriers to comprehensive income tax filing and refunds for the Korean domestic market. However, siloed data systems made it difficult to manage their data in a unified way, creating data engineering overhead that slowed time to insight for the business. With Databricks Data + AI Platform, they now have a unified view into all their data. This has unlocked their ability to democratize data across the organization, enabling more efficient data-driven decision-making, improved business productivity and increased revenue.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow Jobs
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and production jobs.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Coordinates ingestion and transformation workflows across the lakehouse.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in the lakehouse under Unity Catalog governance, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL.
